sentences.text: In the process of formation of a National Highway, NH47B, in Aralvoimozhi Village, the petitioner's land in S.No.755/8B situated at Aralvoimozhi Village, Thovalai Taluk, Kanyakumari District, to an extent of 2200 sq.meter was acquired by the respondents.

sentences.text:
Being not satisfied with the order of the second respondent, the petitioner has preferred an appeal before the first respondent / District Collector under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, on 30.12.2022 and has filed this writ petition for a mandamus directing the first respondent to conclude the proceedings within a reasonable time.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis 2.This Court, while entertaining the writ petition on 03.04.2023, has directed the then learned Government Advocate to get instructions from the first respondent / District Collector as to the outer date within which the appeal preferred by the petitioner would be disposed of.
3.Today, the learned Government Advocate appearing for the respondents sought some more time to get instructions.

sentences.text:

In the process of formation of a National Highway, NH47B, in Aralvoimozhi Village, the petitioner's land in S.No.755/8B situated at Aralvoimozhi Village, Thovalai Taluk, Kanyakumari District, to an extent of 2200 sq.meter was acquired by the respondents.
The second respondent / Special District Revenue Officer has fixed the compensation as Rs.2,61,630/-.
opennyai_summary.10_July_2023__decision:
Being not satisfied with the order of the second respondent, the petitioner has preferred an appeal before the first respondent / District Collector under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, on 30.12.2022 and has filed this writ petition for a mandamus directing the first respondent to conclude the proceedings within a reasonable time.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis 2.This Court, while entertaining the writ petition on 03.04.2023, has directed the then learned Government Advocate to get instructions from the first respondent / District Collector as to the outer date within which the appeal preferred by the petitioner would be disposed of.
3.Today, the learned Government Advocate appearing for the respondents sought some more time to get instructions.
4.Considering the nature of relief and that the appeal is also pending before the first respondent,
this Court dispose of this writ petition with a direction to the first respondent / District Collector to dispose of the petitioner's appeal dated 30.12.2022, on merits and in accordance with law, within a period of sixteen weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order, after affording sufficient opportunity of hearing to the petitioner.

opennyai_summary.final__decision:
The petitioner herein seeks a direction to the respondents to consider her representations dated 29.05.2020, 31.07.2020, 08.09.2020, 21.03.2021, 07.10.2021, 09.02.2022, 21.05.2022 and 19.02.2023, seeking modification of Award No.8/2015-14, dated 24.01.2019, passed by the second respondent in respect of the acquired land situated in Survey Nos.131/5 and 133/06, measuring an extent of 2600 sq.meter, situated in Nagercoil Village, Agastheeswarm Taluk, Kanyakumari District,
within the time stipulated by this Court.
2.Heard the arguments of Mr.V.Sukumar learned counsel appearing for the petitioner and Mr.A.Baskaran, learned Additional Government Pleader appearing for the respondents.
__
The last of the representation was submitted on 19.02.2023, seeking enhancement of compensation.
4.If the land owner is not satisfied with the compensation amount determined by the competent authority, he can make an application seeking enhancement of compensation and the same shall be considered by the Arbitrator under Section 3G(5) of the National Highways Act.
In view of the same,
without expressing any opinion on the merits of the matter, the first respondent is directed to consider the representation of the petitioner dated 19.02.2023, in the light of Section 3G(5) of the _________ https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on: 10/07/2025 03:17:12 pm ) National Highways Act and pass final orders on its own merits within a period of twelve weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
Accordingly, this Writ Petition is disposed of.
